summary: Build, dependency, runtime, installer payload, automated desktop workflow, and repository structure hardening are complete. The generated installer is currently unsigned. Residual release work requires a trusted signing certificate and interactive Windows verification passes.
completed_scope: Low-risk dependency updates applied and audited with no NuGet/npm vulnerabilities reported.
Release gate, web checks, .NET tests, OCR bridge check, installer build, and non-invasive unsigned installer evidence passed.
Representative populated workflow is covered by automated in-process backend tests.
Oversized file review completed with focused splits and documented justifications.

residual_plan.title: Run signed installer lifecycle verification on a clean Windows machine
blocked_by: Trusted code-signing certificate or signing thumbprint not configured.
Current installer artifact is unsigned: artifacts\installer\OnlyRag-Setup-0.1.0-win-x64.exe reports NotSigned.
Clean Windows release verification machine required for install, upgrade, rollback, uninstall, SmartScreen, and signature validation.
execute_when_unblocked: Obtain trusted Windows code-signing certificate and thumbprint.
Record exact machine, Windows version, installer path, signing status, lifecycle result, and any defects.
done_when: Clean-machine install, upgrade or repair, rollback path, uninstall, and SmartScreen checks pass.
No source, local data, logs, temp files, documents, node_modules, databases, or model caches are packaged accidentally.

residual_plan.title: Complete installer wizard layout verification
blocked_by: Requires interactive Windows display scaling changes at 100%, 125%, 150%, and 200%.
execute_when_unblocked: Open every installer wizard page at 100%, 125%, 150%, and 200% display scaling.
Repeat the wizard pass with non-default accessibility text settings.
Capture screenshots or exact observations for each page and scale.
Record every clipping, overlap, truncation, unreadable control, or keyboard/accessibility regression.
done_when: All wizard pages are readable and usable at required scales.
No clipping, overlap, truncation, or unreadable controls remain.
Evidence is recorded with scale, settings, Windows version, and installer artifact.

remaining_risks: Release cannot be considered signed or clean-machine verified until TASK-012 completes.
Installer UI may still have scale/accessibility layout defects until TASK-013 completes.
